nodes.description: Mapping(address=>uint256) balances inherited from BasicToken tracking token balances; heavily mutated by transfer/issue/airdrop/defrozen.
uint256 total supply inherited from BasicToken, set to INITIAL_SUPPLY in FMC constructor.
Nested allowance mapping (address=>address=>uint256) from StandardToken governing approved spending.
Privileged owner address from Ownable; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner modifier.
Custodian address holding all locked/frozen token balances; changeable via updateFrozenAddress.
Mapping(address=>Info) holding per-user lock info (defrozenDates, frozenValues, totalFrozenValue).
Public string URL for the token website, writable via setWebInfo.
FMC constructor(address _frozenAddress): sets custodian, mints INITIAL_SUPPLY to deployer via balances/totalSupply_.
FMC transfer override; performs balance moves and, when _to == frozenAddress, triggers timestamp-based defrost loop over fellowInfo.
onlyOwner batch issuance with optional per-payee freeze; loops payees computing deferDays-derived unlock dates.
onlyOwner airdrop of equal value and deferDays to a payee array; computes a single unlock date.
onlyOwner rotation of the frozen custodian address, migrating the custodial balance.
onlyOwner platform-triggered defrost loop releasing matured locked balances back to a fellow.
View function returning balance, totalFrozenValue, defrozenDates and frozen values for an address.
onlyOwner setter for website and icon metadata strings.
onlyOwner Ownable function transferring contract ownership to newOwner.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, owner check target and constructor owner.
Block timestamp read via now, used for unlock-date comparisons and date normalization.
Unchecked uint16 multiplication deferDays*24*3600 that can overflow the 16-bit type before being widened, corrupting the computed unlock date.
Timestamp-dependent maturity comparison now >= _date0 that gates defrosting; manipulable/variable block time and unbounded loop over defrozenDates.
Constructor parameter naming the initial frozen custodian address.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Array of recipient addresses for issue and airdrop.
Array of issuance amounts for issue.
Freeze-duration parameter (uint16 in issue array, uint16 in airdrop) feeding the unlock-date arithmetic.
Parameter naming the replacement frozen custodian.
Target account parameter of defrozen.
Website string parameter of setWebInfo.
Icon string parameter of setWebInfo.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Local computed unlock timestamp, derived from _now0 + deferDays*86400 and compared against now.
Local midnight-normalized current timestamp from _getNow0().
Storage pointer into fellowInfo for a given account.
Local amount being released from the frozen balance during defrost.
Loop index variable used across batch loops.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so a caller controls the privileged owner role.
_frozenAddress feeds the constructor's custodian assignment.
Constructor initializes balances[msg.sender] with INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Constructor sets totalSupply_ to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
_to is the recipient parameter of transfer.
_value is the amount parameter of transfer.
msg.sender indexes balances as the sender of transfer.
transfer subtracts from sender and adds to recipient balances.
transfer mutates fellowInfo.frozenValues and totalFrozenValue during defrost.
now (block.timestamp) is the left operand of the maturity check now >= _date0.
Timestamp-dependent defrost branch executes inside transfer.
Timestamp-dependent defrost branch executes inside defrozen.
deferDays operand of the unchecked uint16 multiplication deferDays*24*3600.
Computed unlock date is used to allocate frozen balances in issue.
Computed unlock date is used to allocate frozen balances in airdrop.
payees array iterated by issue.
values array consumed by issue.
deferDays array consumed by issue.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before issue body runs.
payees array iterated by airdrop.
deferDays scalar consumed by airdrop.
onlyOwner modifier on airdrop gates execution on msg.sender.
newFrozenAddress is validated and assigned in updateFrozenAddress.
onlyOwner modifier on updateFrozenAddress gates execution on msg.sender.
updateFrozenAddress rewrites the frozenAddress state variable.
fellow selects the fellowInfo entry iterated by defrozen.
onlyOwner modifier on defrozen gates execution on msg.sender.
defrozen moves value from frozenAddress balance to the fellow balance.
defrozen reads and clears fellowInfo frozen values.
getAssets reads balances[fellow].
getAssets reads fellowInfo arrays and values.
_website parameter written by setWebInfo.
_icon parameter written by setWebInfo.
onlyOwner modifier on setWebInfo gates execution on msg.sender.
setWebInfo overwrites the website state variable.
newOwner parameter assigned in transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership gates execution on msg.sender.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged owner variable.
issue debits owner and credits payees/custodian balances.
issue appends defrozenDates and frozen values in fellowInfo.
airdrop credits payees/custodian balances and debits owner.
airdrop appends defrozenDates and frozen values in fellowInfo.
Arithmetic-derived deferDays offset stored into local _date0.
Local _date0 is the right operand of the timestamp maturity comparison.
Local storage pointer _info aliases the fellowInfo mapping entry.
_now0 is derived from block.timestamp via _getNow0/_calcDate0.

normalization_plan.reason: _frozenAddress is only consumed by the constructor and should be folded into it.
_to is a transfer parameter with no independent semantics; fold into transfer.
_value is a transfer parameter; fold into transfer.
payees array is an issue/airdrop parameter; folded into the issuing function.
values array is an issue parameter; fold into issue.
deferDays directly feeds the unchecked uint16 multiply unsafe operation.
newFrozenAddress is a parameter of updateFrozenAddress; fold into it.
fellow is a parameter of defrozen; fold into it.
_website is a setWebInfo parameter; fold into it.
_icon is a setWebInfo parameter; fold into it.
newOwner is a transferOwnership parameter; fold into it.
_date0 is a temporary used only in the timestamp maturity check; fold into the unsafe operation.
_now0 is a temporary base timestamp consumed by the batch issuance logic; fold into issue.
_defrozenValue is a temporary released amount in defrozen; fold into defrozen.
i is a loop index used by the batch loops; fold into the issuing function.
